evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2015 (11 years old), right here: browse.
Moose winter range u-6-018 unit 17 (official), 330 m SW. Counts from November.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from District of Stewart, about 78 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.50298, -129.43252, where the truck road ends (300 Road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.3 km on 300 Road by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 130 m NW, climb about 0 m.
Hunt: moose, Aug, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-17, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-03, closures 2026-10-16.
R6L-moose-atv-0005.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-17: about 723 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.07 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
